feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Vincent Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at Bayern Munich training
articles.summary: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany has been taken to hospital after collapsing at the club's training ground.

articles.title: Airbnb hosts can't ask guests to do 'chores' anymore in rule change
articles.summary: Airbnb hosts will no longer be able to ask guests to do the dishes or strip the beds under new rules announced by the platform.

articles.title: What is in the Be Ready checklist as Britons urged to stock up for emergencies?
articles.summary: The British public is being urged to stockpile food, water and emergency supplies as part of national efforts to prepare the UK for any potential crises.

articles.title: Three people linked to Conservatives sentenced after cheating at gambling on general election
articles.summary: Three people linked to the Conservatives, including the party's former director of campaigning, have been given suspended sentences after admitting to cheating at gambling on the 2024 general election date.

articles.title: Items recovered in search for missing fishing boat and crew
articles.summary: Items belonging to a fishing boat that vanished off the Western Isles have been recovered as searches continue for the vessel and two missing crew members.

articles.title: New charges for Royal Navy sailor accused of plotting to leak secrets to Russia
articles.summary: A junior Royal Navy serviceman is facing additional charges after being accused of plotting to leak classified information to Russia.

articles.title: Police officer raped by David Carrick waives anonymity and says Met chief must resign
articles.summary: A police detective raped by fellow officer and notorious sexual predator David Carrick has called for the head of the Metropolitan Police to resign.

articles.title: Man 'sexually obsessed' with stepdaughter jailed for her murder
articles.summary: A man who had a secret sexual obsession with his stepdaughter before going on to murder her has been jailed for at least 35 years.

articles.title: Meghan's father investigated by police over child sex abuse image claims
articles.summary: The Duchess of Sussex has said she is "deeply distressed" by allegations that her estranged father possessed child sex abuse images.

articles.title: The national resilience moment that almost unfolded in silence - in stark contrast to NATO allies
articles.summary: It was the national resilience moment that very nearly barely happened.
